body:
Update from the 2026-08-28 run, with the evidence that has changed since this issue was filed.

I re-proposed `https://cursor.com/resources/grok-4-6-model-card.pdf` this morning without knowing #28 and #31 already existed — nothing in the agent's inputs (`state_summary.json`, `candidates.json`, `open_issues.json`) records prior rejections, and `open_issues.json` was empty this run because Phase B could not reach the GitHub API. The proposal was routed to needs-review again, so a third issue on the same URL is in the outbox. Apologies for the duplicate; please treat #28, #31 and the incoming one as one thread. (The underlying gap is logged to `friction.jsonl` this run.)

The new fact, verified today by downloading both files:

| | xAI (`media.x.ai/…/card-4p6-4cd2dc57.pdf`) | Cursor (`cursor.com/resources/grok-4-6-model-card.pdf`) |
|---|---|---|
| md5 | `7640cdde745a18a2390cd5fbde55fd55` | `5faf54cc75e26c987541719b7e2d56f1` |
| size | 540,844 B | 524,224 B |
| cover | Revision: 2026-08-17 | Revision: 2026-08-12 |

Word-level diff similarity is 0.705, so the two copies are no longer the same document by any measure except the stored launch-day fingerprint the dedup check matches against. xAI's changelog for the 08-17 revision reads: renumbered sections; added PartBench results and graph; added new DeepSearchQA results; KernelBenchInternal updated to v1.1; clarity updates; and "Corrected eval results on HackerBench v0.2, Self-harm, MASK, LAB". Cursor's copy is currently the only public edition carrying the pre-correction numbers for those four safety and behavioural evals.

When #28 was filed on 2026-08-13 the two files were byte-identical, so the "likely a mirror or moved copy" reading was reasonable then. It is no longer the situation. I have also corrected the `notes` on `xai-grok-4-6-model-card`, which still asserted byte-identity, to describe the divergence.

No action requested beyond adjudicating the three issues together. The structural ask — making the content-duplicate check publisher-aware so a launch-partner co-publication is distinguishable from a mirror — is already written up in `logs/PROPOSALS.md` under 2026-08-22.
